messages.subject: Analytics Competition
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I wanted to inform you about the Annual DMA Analytics Challenge. This year’s challenge involves helping Cleveland Clinic  optimize its patient re-activation campaigns and winners get speaking opportunities at the Annual DMA Conference and NCDM Big Data Conference.  You can find out additional details and register at

http://dmachallenge13.analyticscompetition.com/

Regards,

Krishna
